response.sql: WITH per_state AS (SELECT c.State AS State, SUM(i.Total) AS total_sum, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE CAST(i.InvoiceDate AS TEXT) >= '2010-06-22 00:00:00' AND CAST(i.InvoiceDate AS TEXT) <= '2012-06-26 00:00:00' GROUP BY c.State) SELECT SUM(total_sum) AS total_of_state_totals, AVG(invoice_count * 1.0) AS avg_invoices_per_state FROM per_state
